variants.headline: Home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has punished the colony. The action establishes a punitive development in the relationship, not the particular effects of that action. Scrutiny of {target} should address the use of authority without adding an unreported restriction, financial loss or change in supplies to the account.

Punitive action deserves a careful commercial assessment, but its existence does not identify a cost. Owners and managers should not presume a particular restriction on trade, finance or materials from the label alone. The sensible approach is to distinguish the political event from its still unspecified operating terms.

The position of {target} should be assessed without supplying an unreported offence or penalty. This paper records the punitive action while reserving judgment on particulars not established in the report. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
